title: AWS Data Architect
description:
About the Role

AWS Data Architect – Hybrid Cloud, Data Migration & Legacy Modernization

We are seeking an AWS Data Architect with deep expertise in hybrid cloud environments, on-prem to AWS migrations, ETL modernization, and legacy application analysis. This role will lead the transformation of multiple traditional on-premise systems—including databases, applications, ETL pipelines, and BI workloads—into modern, scalable cloud architectures.

You will work across several business verticals (HR, Corporate Finance, and Real Estate), collaborating closely with Cloud Engineering, Cloud Operations, BI, Data, and Application teams. The ideal candidate is hands-on, autonomous, and highly skilled at reverse-engineering systems in environments with little or no documentation.

Key Responsibilities

Cloud Architecture & Migration Strategy

· Lead end-to-end migration of on-prem systems (databases, applications, ETL, BI workloads) into AWS.

· Work with Oracle, SQL Server, ODI, legacy ETL flows, Java, Angular, OBIEE/OAS, SSRS, and BI Publisher.

· Define migration paths (lift-and-shift, re-platform, modernization).

· Architect AWS solutions leveraging services such as S3, Glue, Athena, DMS, EC2, Lambda, RDS/Aurora, IAM.

· Ensure data and application continuity for systems that remain on-prem.

· Contribute to data lake and analytical architecture design.

Legacy System Assessment

· Independently analyze and document complex legacy systems covering:

o Oracle & SQL Server structures, dependencies, logic, triggers, procedures.

o ODI mappings, packages, workflows, and transformations.

o Java and Angular applications and their data interactions.

o BI metadata layers and report logic (OBIEE/OAS, SSRS, BI Publisher).

o Batch processes, data flows, and integrations across HR, Finance, and Real Estate.

· Reverse-engineer systems with minimal support or documentation.

Hybrid Architecture & Data Synchronization

· Design architectures that span on-premise and AWS environments.

· Support scenarios where significant workloads remain on-prem.

· Build synchronization patterns for:

o On-prem ETL (ODI) sustaining local applications.

o Cloud ingestion for analytics and reporting.

· Ensure reliability and performance across hybrid data flows.

· Collaborate with infrastructure teams on Direct Connect, VPN, and related networking.

Data Engineering & ETL Modernization

· Translate business logic from Oracle/SQL Server into cloud-native technologies.

· Modernize ETL from ODI into AWS Glue, Python, SQL (Athena/PostgreSQL).

· Reimplement complex transformation rules while preserving business logic.

· Support semantic layer design, data modeling, and analytical datasets.

BI & Data Warehouse Migration

· Migrate BI workloads (OBIEE/OAS, SSRS, BI Publisher) into AWS.

· Rebuild and validate BI logic within cloud-based architectures.

· Apply data warehouse concepts (dimensional modeling, marts, semantic layers).

· Partner with BI teams on testing and rollout.

Compliance, Governance & Cloud Standards

· Operate within established cloud guardrails, IAM policies, and security frameworks.

· Ensure architecture aligns with organizational standards.

· Collaborate with Cloud Engineering and Cloud Operations for governance and infrastructure.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

· Engage with business analysts, data owners, and application teams.

· Work across diverse business domains with complex data landscapes.

· Maintain alignment with cloud, BI, data, and application initiatives.

Required Skills & Experience

Technical Expertise

· Strong experience designing hybrid cloud architectures (on-prem + AWS).

· Deep knowledge of Oracle and SQL Server, including advanced logic.

· Hands-on experience with ODI/ODEE and ETL reverse engineering.

· Experience with Tableau, Qlik, ThoughtSpot, or similar BI tools.

· Understanding of Java, Angular, and reporting/BI applications.

· Experience with OBIEE/OAS, SSRS, BI Publisher.

· Solid understanding of data modeling, data warehouse concepts, and analytical systems.

· Proficiency with AWS services: S3, Glue, Athena, DMS, EC2, Lambda, RDS/Aurora, IAM.

· Experience with hybrid connectivity (Direct Connect, VPN).

· Proficiency in Python.

Behavioral & Professional Skills

· Highly independent, resourceful, and comfortable with ambiguity.

· Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and critical thinking skills.

· Curious and proactive learner, able to master unfamiliar systems quickly.

· Hands-on, ownership-driven mindset.

· Strong communication and documentation capabilities.

· Ability to work across diverse business domains and technical stacks.

· Fluent English.

Nice to Have

· Exposure to financial or banking data domains.

· AWS Certifications: Solutions Architect, Data Engineer, Developer.

· Knowledge of Azure or other cloud providers in legacy environments.

Additional Information

· Work hours aligned to U.S. Eastern Time (EST).

· Remote from Brazil.

Why build your carrer at Meta?

We offer autonomy, clear goals and a dynamic and challenging environment, where professionals have the opportunity to interact with different technologies, participate in all types of projects, bring new ideas and work from anywhere in Brazil and (why not?) anywhere in the world. In addition, we are one of the best companies to work for in Brazil according to Great Place to Work and one of the 10 fastest growing technology companies in the country for 3 consecutive years, according to Anuário Informático Hoje.

What are our values?

- We are people serving people

- We all think and act like owners

- We are hungry for performance

- We grow and learn together

- We pursue excellence and simplicity

- We have innovation and creativity in our DNA

All people are welcome regardless of their condition, disability, ethnicity, religious belief, sexual orientation, appearance, age or others. We want you to grow up with us in a welcoming environment full of opportunities.

Did you relate? Then, #ComeBeMeta!

title: SAP Basis Consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for SAP Basis Consultant who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Technical

Strong knowledge of IT Service Management, SAP Basis and SAP Applications

Hands-on experience with SAP Basis activities, SAP release version upgrades and infrastructure updates for cloud customers

Working experience with SAP HEC, SAP S/4HANA or any other cloud solution.

Hands-on experience with infrastructure operations, network, interfaces and Load Balancer topics related to SAP landscape management (TLO)

Strong technical troubleshooting skills with the ability to form the solution/designing the mechanism for end to end solutioning

Hands on experience in Migration (onpremise to Cloud/Cross cloud/Cross DC's)


Soft Skills

Excellent customer focus / Networking / Relationship Building /Results-driven / Self-organized / Decision making

Excellent communication skills (written and verbal)

Understanding of escalation handling and procedures with customers while proactively working with internal teams towards arriving at a resolution

Experience in working with cross-cultural and cross-functional teams or individuals

Proficiency in English (Written and verbal)


Good to have

Cloud architecture and IT technical infrastructure know-how

Knowledge of/certification in one of Azure, AWS or GCP fundamentals

Experience with Migration, Upgrade projects esp. on S/4H Cloud

Knowledge of Project Management Fundamentals, ITIL, Lean Fundamentals is a plus



What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Childcare assistance

Gympass

title: Tech Lead – Inteligência Artificial (AI)
description:
#RESV57342


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.



- O que procuramos?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Tech Lead de Inteligência Artificial para liderar tecnicamente projetos estratégicos de desenvolvimento de plataformas de agentes de IA , atuando desde a concepção da arquitetura até a entrega e evolução contínua das soluções.

Essa posição é ideal para quem combina excelência técnica , visão arquitetural e capacidade de liderança , com forte interesse em soluções modernas de IA aplicada a problemas reais de negócio.


- O que você deve ter?

  • Experiência sólida como Tech Lead / Líder Técnico ou função equivalente.
  • Domínio em Python e/ou Node.js .
  • Experiência em projetos de Inteligência Artificial , Machine Learning ou soluções baseadas em LLMs.
  • Conhecimento em APIs, microsserviços, cloud e arquiteturas modernas.
  • Capacidade de tomada de decisão técnica e liderança de times de engenharia.


- Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar tecnicamente projetos de plataformas de agentes de IA (multiagentes, orquestração, integrações com LLMs).
  • Definir arquitetura, padrões técnicos e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Atuar hands-on no desenvolvimento utilizando Python e/ou Node.js .
  • Orientar e mentorar desenvolvedores, garantindo qualidade, escalabilidade e manutenibilidade do código.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com áreas de produto, arquitetura e negócio.
  • Avaliar e incorporar novas tecnologias, frameworks e abordagens em Inteligência Artificial.


- Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com plataformas de agentes de IA , RAG, LangChain ou frameworks de orquestração.
  • Vivência em ambientes cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Experiência em produtos de dados, IA generativa ou plataformas internas.
  • Boa comunicação e visão estratégica.



- O que temos pra te oferecer?

  • Atuação em projetos estratégicos de IA , com impacto direto no negócio.
  • Ambiente de alto nível técnico, com autonomia e espaço para inovação.
  • Oportunidade de liderar a construção de soluções modernas e escaláveis de IA.



- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.



- O que procuramos?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Tech Lead de Inteligência Artificial para liderar tecnicamente projetos estratégicos de desenvolvimento de plataformas de agentes de IA , atuando desde a concepção da arquitetura até a entrega e evolução contínua das soluções.

Essa posição é ideal para quem combina excelência técnica , visão arquitetural e capacidade de liderança , com forte interesse em soluções modernas de IA aplicada a problemas reais de negócio.


- O que você deve ter?

  • Experiência sólida como Tech Lead / Líder Técnico ou função equivalente.
  • Domínio em Python e/ou Node.js .
  • Experiência em projetos de Inteligência Artificial , Machine Learning ou soluções baseadas em LLMs.
  • Conhecimento em APIs, microsserviços, cloud e arquiteturas modernas.
  • Capacidade de tomada de decisão técnica e liderança de times de engenharia.


- Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar tecnicamente projetos de plataformas de agentes de IA (multiagentes, orquestração, integrações com LLMs).
  • Definir arquitetura, padrões técnicos e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Atuar hands-on no desenvolvimento utilizando Python e/ou Node.js .
  • Orientar e mentorar desenvolvedores, garantindo qualidade, escalabilidade e manutenibilidade do código.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com áreas de produto, arquitetura e negócio.
  • Avaliar e incorporar novas tecnologias, frameworks e abordagens em Inteligência Artificial.


- Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com plataformas de agentes de IA , RAG, LangChain ou frameworks de orquestração.
  • Vivência em ambientes cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Experiência em produtos de dados, IA generativa ou plataformas internas.
  • Boa comunicação e visão estratégica.



- O que temos pra te oferecer?

  • Atuação em projetos estratégicos de IA , com impacto direto no negócio.
  • Ambiente de alto nível técnico, com autonomia e espaço para inovação.
  • Oportunidade de liderar a construção de soluções modernas e escaláveis de IA.



- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Back End Java Developer
description:
Position: Back End Java Developer

Location: REMOTE in Brazil, Chile, Columbia, or Costa Rica

Duration: 12-month contract

Pay Rate: $30-40/hour (depending on experience)


Required Skills & Experience:

  • 5-6 years of backend development experience
  • Strong proficiency in Java, SpringBoot, Microservices, SQL/PostgreSQL
  • Knowledge of Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
  • Solid understanding of integration architecture and backend services
  • Strong debugging, problem-solving, and analytical skills


Nice to Have Skills & Experience:

  • POS/Retail experience
  • Triaging/troubleshooting
  • Familiarity with JumpMind or similar POS Technology


Job Description:

Insight Global is hiring a Backend Developer to join our Transaction Team, supporting high‑impact integration and feature work within our clients POS ecosystem. This role centers on backend engineering with a strong focus on Java-based development, data processing, and fresh feature builds. The ideal candidate is a sharp, analytical engineer who can ramp up quickly and contribute to both new development and production support as needed. This role is primarily focused on new development (80-90%) with occasional involvement in production issue resolution (10-15%).

title: Javascript/React Software Developer – Contractor
description:
Position: Javascript/React Software Developer – Contractor

Location: Remote – Brazil

Contract Type: Service Contract (PJ/Freelancer)

Role Overview:

We are seeking a Software Developer with strong expertise in Javascript and React and proven web programming experience. The ideal candidate is also comfortable working with other programming languages, has advanced coding skills, and in-depth knowledge of modern HTML/CSS.

Responsibilities:

  • Write well-structured, testable, and efficient code following best development practices.
  • Create website layouts and user interfaces using modern HTML/CSS standards.
  • Integrate data from multiple back-end services and databases.
  • Develop back-end services using Node.js.
  • Work with other programming languages as required.
  • Stay up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends, applying them to projects.
  • Collaborate with designers to ensure visual design alignment.
  • Preferred: experience with mobile development (iOS/Android) or React Native.

Requirements & Skills:

  • Solid experience in Javascript, React, and Node.js.
  • Strong programming skills and in-depth knowledge of modern HTML/CSS.
  • Understanding of web application functionality, including security and best practices.
  • Proven track record in web programming.
  • Knowledge of relational databases, object-oriented programming, and web application development.
  • Problem-solving and creative diagnosis skills.
  • Strong organizational skills to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
  • Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new technologies.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
  • Fluent English (written and spoken).

Nice-to-Haves / Differentials:

  • Experience with Web3, MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js).
  • Mobile app development and integration with hardware SDKs, drones, or sensors.
  • Experience with prototyping, algorithms, R&D, QA, and software quality assurance.

Contract Details:

  • Contractor will work under a service agreement (PJ/Freelancer).
  • Contractor will issue monthly invoices for services rendered.
  • No employment relationship (CLT), and no employment benefits (transportation, vacation, 13th salary, etc.) are provided.
  • Flexible hours and autonomy in executing tasks, while meeting project deadlines and deliverables.

Keywords: Javascript, React, Node.js, MERN Stack, MongoDB, Express, Front-end, Back-end, Mobile (iOS/Android), React Native, Web Development, Software Development, R&D, Prototyping, QA, Algorithms, Engineering, Technology.

O termo Conforme + Dominante vem do teste comportamental DISC , que classifica o comportamento das pessoas em quatro perfis principais:

  • D – Dominância
  • I – Influência
  • S – Estabilidade
  • C – Conformidade

No caso, “Conforme + Dominante ” significa que a pessoa tem predominância nas características de Conformidade (C) , mas também apresenta traços de Dominância (D) .

Isso gera um perfil que normalmente é:

Conforme (C) – Característica principal

  • Extremamente organizada
  • Segue processos e padrões
  • Atenta a detalhes
  • Gosta de fazer certo da primeira vez
  • Preocupada com qualidade e precisão

Dominante (D) – Característica secundária

  • Decidida e assertiva
  • Focada em resultados
  • Não tem medo de assumir responsabilidades
  • Capaz de tomar decisões rápidas
  • Sabe cobrar e manter prazos

  • 3+ years of backend development experience in Java (Spring Boot / Spring Cloud).
  • Hands-on experience with REST APIs and microservices architecture.
  • Knowledge of relational databases (SQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle) and messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar).
  • Solid grasp of distributed systems and SWIFT message standards (MX, MT).

description:
Hunter Douglas is the world’s leading manufacturer of window coverings and a major manufacturer of architectural products. We are a brand that you know and trust. With more than 100 years of innovation, we’ve defined our industry with proprietary products that deliver revolutionary style and functionality and can be found in millions of homes and commercial buildings globally.

We are searching for candidates that are driven, intelligent, creative, and entrepreneurial. By offering challenging and accelerated opportunities for growth, powered by a shared hunger for success, we create a space for your career to thrive. In return for your expertise, we are committed to providing competitive and robust total compensation and benefit packages to ensure you feel valued. Our dream is to become the fastest growing, most loved, window covering company in the world. What’s yours?

Position Overview

The Hunter Douglas Global Management Trainee Program (GMT) is hand-selected and sponsored by the Executive Leadership Team. This 10-month comprehensive Leadership Development program provides you with the tools and experiences to develop you into a future leader of our organization while providing a holistic view of the business. Throughout this program, you will immediately immerse yourself into the company, the culture, and the industry. You will join a class of other Trainees and gain a community of ambitious peers. You will learn from Hunter Douglas leaders and contribute directly to our purpose and our DREAM. You will gain insights from day one and do real work on different projects while delivering actual results.

Before the program commences, Trainees are paired with a Mentor to help acclimate and integrate you to our organization. Throughout the program, you can expect opportunities to connect and collaborate with our Executive Leadership Team, Global Leaders, Business Leaders, previous Trainees and current Trainees from other Zones.

What you'll do

  • Three weeks of onboarding - one week of local onboarding at your designated hub location and zone.
    • Global Induction at our HQ - providing an introduction to our company's strategy, culture, products, sales channels and problem-solving approaches.
  • Five months of Field Training in which you will rotate through key areas of our value chain including Sales, Supply, Logistics, Product, Customer Service, and will gain hands-on experience by actively participating in daily operations and project work during each rotation.
  • One week of Leadership and Methodology training to foster a unified system-thinking approach and prepare you for your first project.
  • A four-month individual project in which you will be able to deliver tangible and measurable results as an active team member by applying methodology skills and technical knowledge.
  • Capstone presentation of your project to Leadership, followed by feedback and final placement into a full-time role upon program completion - designed to support your continued leadership development and long-term career growth with Hunter Douglas.
  • First Position Placement can be in any of the following areas: Sales, Operations (Supply, Logistics, Procurement), Product, or Functional.

Below are examples of projects that previous Trainees' have worked on

  • Create a new implementation process for when Hunter Douglas introduces a new product.
  • Implement recommendations to optimize material usage and mitigate scrap rates at our plants.
  • Pricing Analysis for our e-commerce platforms.
  • Develop a communication strategy to enhance our customer installation journey.
  • Monetize our Market Funnel valuation by quantifying our conversion rates.

Qualifications:

  • To qualify, candidates must have an expected graduation date of December 2025
  • Have demonstrated leadership capabilities through various extracurricular activities including job experiences, internships, student clubs and organizations, and volunteer work.
  • Must be fully mobile and willing to be on-site at one of our major locations throughout the program. Be ready to tackle new challenges in diverse environments, including front line roles in the field, manufacturing plants, regional offices, among others.

Who you are

  • Hard-working and enjoys a high level of responsibility.
  • Hungry for success, yet humble to continuously learn.
  • You think like an owner and take accountability for your actions.
  • Problem-Solver who leads with agility and acts with a sense of urgency.
  • Intellectually curious and willing to challenge the status quo.
  • A natural leader who enjoys collaborating with teams to complete ambitious but achievable big goals.
  • Strong interest in a multi-functional career with a readiness to work hard to become a future leader in our global company.
  • Trainees are expected to live our values, our culture, and be ambassadors of the program and future leaders of the organization.

What's in it for you

  • Competitive compensation package

title: Engenheiro De Controle
description:
About Woodgrove


We are a leading provider of energy efficient, innovative equipment, instrumentation, and process control systems to the global mining industry. With companies in Brazil, Chile, Mexico, and South Africa, Woodgrove has built a reputation based on quality, performance, and safety. The company is entrepreneurial, dynamic and our team are driven to succeed. We are looking for like-minded individuals that want to be part of a transformational business.


Role Summary

This role is for a position within the Advanced Process Control (APC) department. The APC department works with mine sites around the world (both remotely and on site) to deploy and integrate optimization solutions for the benefit of clients and industry. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys travelling and has an analytical mind.


All resumes must be in english.


Responsibilities

  • Development, deployment, and integration of Advanced Regulatory Control applications
  • Support deployment and integration of Expert Systems
  • Analyze and troubleshoot control system issues and provide solutions to improve system performance and reliability.
  • Experience commissioning and tuning of control systems.
  • Produce technical documentation (e.G., reports, manuals, specifications, drawings)
  • Conduct data analyses.
  • Verification and validation of software through inspection, simulation, and testing
  • Work with cross-functional teams to develop and implement control systems for new projects.
  • Perform regular reviews and upgrades on existing control systems to ensure optimal performance.
  • Ensure compliance with safety regulations and industry standards.


Qualifications/Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Control and Automation Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
  • English: intermediate, conversation level
  • Extensive experience in a control engineering project environment
  • Knowledge and axperience with multiple control systems, including PLCs, SCADA systems, and DCS systems (ABB, DeltaV, Siemens, Rockwell, Schneider, Honeywell, etc.)
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot control systems.
  • Proficiency with programming languages such as Ladder Logic, Function Block Diagram, and Structured text
  • Strong written, communication and interpersonal skills
  • Familiarity with industry standards and regulations related to control systems.

title: Finance Manager (Brazil)
description:
The Finance Manager will oversee all financial, accounting, and tax functions for the Brazilian entity, ensuring compliance with local statutory requirements, tax regulations, and corporate reporting standards. The role encompasses daily accounting operations, month-end and year-end closings, and statutory audits, while providing management with financial analysis, budgeting support, and strategic guidance. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical accounting expertise, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to excel in a fast-paced start-up environment.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for the maintenance of accurate financial reports and accounting records in line with corporate guidelines, corporate timelines and local statutory requirements.
  • Manage the full spectrum of the accounting functions, including accounts payables, accounts receivables, balance sheet schedules, general ledger maintenance, and cash flow management.
  • Manage closing processes and preparation of accurate and timely financial reports and analysis of financial information.
  • Ensure compliance with all federal, state, and municipal tax obligations.
  • Manage tax incentives including PPB (Processo Produtivo Básico) and tax optimization opportunities ensuring compliance with Brazilian tax laws.
  • Coordinate and liaise with external parties (e.G. banks, external auditors, tax agents, corporate secretarial agents, local tax and government authorities) to ensure smooth operations.
  • Collaborate across departments in preparing and managing the OPEX budgets.
  • Identify and implement process improvements in internal accounting and financial operations efficiency.
  • Partner with business units to provide finance-related advice.
  • Coordinate with headquarters to align local reporting with group consolidation requirements.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting.
  • Minimum 7 years of experience in finance and tax management, including 3+ years in an international setting.
  • Knowledge of Direct and Indirect tax.
  • Advanced analytical skills and high attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact with all levels of the organization.
  • Ability to work independently, manage pressure, and meet tight deadlines.
  • Proficiency in English.
  • Prior experience in accounting firms is an added advantage.

description:
Business Intelligence Partner

Location: Sao Paulo Brazil


about Randstad Enterprise

Randstad Sourceright is a global talent leader, providing solutions and expertise that help companies position for growth, execute on strategy, and improve business agility. Our experience encompasses all facets of the talent acquisition of permanent employees and the contingent and contractor workforce. Key offerings include Managed Services Provider (MSP) programs, Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO), and Blended Workforce Solutions. Randstad Sourceright offers solutions Globally in North America, EMEA, and APAC. Working for a multi-country organization means working with clients and colleagues from different backgrounds. This results in a digital way of working and requires a proactive and culturally inclusive mindset.


job context

and purpose


Purpose of the job

This role aims to partner with the Regional and global BI customers within RSR (who can include but are not limited to Data engineering, BI Support Teams, Operational Teams, Internal teams, and RSR clients) and provide business solutions through data.

This position has operational and technical responsibility for reporting, analytics, and visualization dashboards across all operating companies within RSR. This position will develop processes and strategies to consolidate, automate, and improve reporting and dashboards for external clients and internal stakeholders.

As a Business Intelligence Partner, you will oversee the end-to-end delivery of regional and global account and client BI reporting. This will include working with data engineering to provide usable datasets, creating dashboards with meaningful insights & visualizations within our BI solution, and ongoing communication and partnering with the ‘BI consumers. Must be knowledgeable in Tableau and SQL. The key to this is that as a Business Intelligence Partner, you will be a commercial and operational expert who can translate data into insights. You will use this to mitigate risk, find operational and revenue-generating opportunities, and provide business solutions.


Key stakeholders

  • RSR internal stakeholders include but are not limited to C-Suite, Finance, Regional Managing Directors, Vice Presidents, and operational account leaders.
  • RSR external clients


Position Summary

Development of BI solutions (50%):

  • Responsible for delivering BI solutions for the program
  • Responsible for ensuring all contractual conditions around reporting, financial elements, SLA's, and KPI's are reviewed, understood, and adhered to
  • Assess operating reality to validate solution requirements and adjust as needed.
  • Implement and reinforce tools, including standards, procedures, and documentation.
  • Ensure the team has living documentation on reporting requirements, data processes, and other program-specific content.
  • Oversee the design and build of insightful, scalable, and actionable visualizations.
  • Develop, document, and maintain a comprehensive quality management program
  • Build, implement, and schedule production standards of files and reports to ensure accuracy and timeliness.
  • Ensure reporting quality and accuracy by evaluating, integrating, and complementing data sources.
  • Execute continuous process improvement process.
  • Knowledge of general database functions, data storage, data models, SQL, and data transfer protocols

Consult (30%):

  • Responsible for being the liaison between the external client, operations teams and the wider BI teams
  • Using client data and insights to highlight and provide observations, provide recommendations, and contribute to ongoing business discussions and decision-making.
  • Analyze the client’s data to present the account leadership and client with potential approaches or opportunities for improving service delivery performance and elevating value-added opportunities.
  • Have commercial awareness and work with the account leadership to maximize revenue-generating opportunities.
  • Solicit feedback from internal and external stakeholders in an organized manner to contribute to the objectives of the BI team and demonstrate RSR value.
  • Contribute to the success of a wider global team.
  • Qualify the business needs of each request and use expertise to partner on solutions.
  • Develop strong working relationships with the client stakeholders and account leads.
  • Serve as a functional and technical data visualization and business intelligence subject matter expert.

Maintain Standards (20%):

  • Work within the agreed parameters aligned to the global method of BI production
  • Leverage an agile work environment to incorporate new innovative and value components into existing portfolios
  • Organize a feedback standard from stakeholders (internal and external) in order to create use case, case study materials and other customer-facing material
  • Promote available resources and enterprise tools for operations training/ coaching needs from a BI perspective.
  • Ensure data governance principles and guidelines are being met


job

  • 2+ years of experience in a similar role
  • Project Management and/or process improvement experience

title: Facility Manager
description:
Americas Cluster Operations Team


We are the Americas Cluster Operations Team, a critical component of a leading global technology enterprise's infrastructure strategy. Our mission is to ensure the highly efficient, stable, and secure operation of the operational environment across the Americas. We are dedicated to delivering "last mile customer value" from our operational facilities, providing a seamless, reliable, and highly efficient service experience.


Our team comprises dedicated professionals in Facilities, IT, and Asset Management, deeply experienced in large-scale system operations, possessing comprehensive capabilities from daily operations to strategic planning:

Facilities Team: Responsible for 24x7 uninterrupted operations and emergency response of critical physical support systems within the large operational environment, including electrical, HVAC, and fire suppression. We ensure physical environment stability and sustainable operations through rigorous capacity management and energy efficiency optimization.

IT Team: Manages the full lifecycle operations of IT equipment like servers and networks within the operational environment. We ensure high SLA compliance for IT services through proactive systemic risk governance, automation, and process optimization, while leading various technology upgrade projects.

Asset Team: Oversees the full lifecycle management and governance of IT assets. We ensure asset compliance, visibility, and efficient utilization through precise data management, risk control, and cost-efficiency strategies.


Our Core Focuses:

End-to-End Reliability: From physical support to IT services, we provide comprehensive stability assurance, focused on mitigating risks and ensuring business continuity.

Project-Based & Lean Operations: We approach operational work through a project lens, continuously optimizing processes to achieve efficient resource utilization and lean operating costs.

Innovation & Talent Development: We actively integrate cutting-edge technologies and foster robust knowledge-sharing mechanisms to continuously enhance our team's professional capabilities and innovative practices.

We serve as the robust foundation for the enterprise's business growth in the Americas, providing powerful and trustworthy infrastructure assurance through professionalism, innovation, and collaboration.


Job Responsibilities:

1. Responsible for the daily operation and maintenance management of large-scale operational facilities within the responsible region, ensuring the efficient, stable, and compliant operation of their critical physical support systems (e.G., power, HVAC, fire suppression).

2. Develop and implement facility operation strategies, procedures, and emergency plans, ensuring facility operations comply with internal standards and external regulations.

3. Manage the facility operations team, including recruitment, training, performance evaluation, and daily supervision, to enhance team professionalism and cohesion.

4. Lead facility capacity planning, energy efficiency management, and optimization projects, promoting sustainable operation practices and reducing operational costs.

5. Manage facility-related vendors and service providers, ensuring service quality and SLA compliance.

6. Lead or participate in root cause analysis for facility incidents, and the development and implementation of corrective actions.

7. Collaborate closely with internal cross-functional teams (e.G., IT, Security, Business Units) to ensure facility operations effectively support overall business objectives.


Job Requirements:

1. Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, HVAC, Automation, or a related engineering discipline.

2. Over 8 years of experience in large-scale facility operation and maintenance, with at least 3 years in a management role;
experience in multinational corporations preferred.

3. Familiar with the operational principles, maintenance, and troubleshooting of critical physical support systems.

4. Proven team leadership and project management skills, capable of effectively driving complex project implementation.

5. Familiar with relevant safety regulations, industry standards, and environmental compliance.

6. Strong communication and coordination skills, problem-solving abilities, and risk management awareness.

7. Fluent in English, able to communicate effectively as a working language.

8. (Plus) Relevant professional certifications (e.G., PMP, CFM) are a plus.

9. (Plus) Familiarity with energy efficiency management and green operation practices is a plus.

title: Account Manager
description:
Altenar is a leading provider of sportsbook software and services to licensed gaming operators. We deliver a complete range of solutions — from “software-only” offerings to fully managed sports betting platform stacks — ensuring stability, flexibility, and personalized service . Our software is developed and operated entirely in-house and powered by premium-quality data feeds .


Role Overview

We are seeking a proactive, passionate, and dedicated Account Manager to act as the main point of contact between our clients and internal teams. The ideal candidate will have a strong focus on client satisfaction, relationship management, and operational excellence, ensuring that each client receives outstanding support and value from our products and services.


Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary contact for client needs, inquiries, and concerns.
  • Build and nurture strong client relationships to foster retention and growth.
  • Oversee client accounts, ensuring services meet business goals, expectations, and budgets.
  • Collaborate with internal teams — including sales, product, and operations — to deliver tailored solutions.
  • Proactively identify and resolve issues, continuously improving client experience and internal processes.
  • Work closely with the product team to align updates and features with client expectations.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of Altenar’s offerings to identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling.
  • Act as a trusted advisor and advocate for clients, ensuring a seamless and positive partnership.


Requirements & Skills:

  • Languages: Portuguese (proficient), English (intermediate or higher).
  • Previous experience in account management, sales, or customer service .
  • Strong multitasking and organizational skills with excellent attention to detail.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to collect, track, and interpret data effectively.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
  • Problem-solving attitude and adaptability in fast-paced environments.
  • Proven ability to build rapport and collaborate with diverse teams.
  • Experience in the sports betting or iGaming industry is a strong advantage.


What We Offer

  • A stable, flexible, and collaborative working environment.
  • Ongoing training and professional development opportunities.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.
  • A multinational team of industry experts from around the world.


Please, submit your CV in English when applying for this vacancy.

title: Coordenador Fiscal - Torre De Faturamento
description:
Briefing da posição:


Como Coordenador/Supervisor Fiscal da Torre de Faturamento, o profissional será responsável por liderar a operação fiscal vinculada ao faturamento da empresa (“torre” de faturamento), assegurando o correto processamento de notas fiscais, apuração de tributos diretos e indiretos, cumprimento de obrigações acessórias, e a entrega de resultados por meio de KPIs.


Espera-se perfil de liderança, domínio técnico e capacidade de interface executiva (internamente com Financeiro, Faturamento, Contabilidade, Comercial, e externamente com clientes). O inglês avançado será requisito para interação com equipes globais ou clientes internacionais.


Principais responsabilidades:


  • Coordenar as atividades da torre de faturamento: emissão e conferência de notas fiscais (saídas/entradas), conferência de faturamento, retenções, XML, NFS-e/NF-e, CTe, etc.
  • Garantir o cumprimento de obrigações acessórias: SPED Fiscal, SPED Contribuições, DCTF, EFD-Contribuições, REINF, ECF/ECD, etc;
  • Implantar e monitorar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) da operação fiscal/faturamento (por exemplo: % de notas com erro fiscal, tempo de processamento, custo por nota, índice de credits fiscais aproveitados, SLA de faturamento, conformidade) e reportar à liderança executiva;
  • Desenvolver e liderar a equipe da torre (coordenados e analistas), promovendo treinamento, engajamento, definição de metas, monitoramento de performance e melhorias contínuas de processo;
  • Interface com Financeiro, Contabilidade, Comercial/Vendas, TI/ERP e auditoria, assegurando que as operações de faturamento estejam alinhadas aos controles internos, aos requisitos de compliance e às estratégias de negócio;
  • Liderar ou participar de iniciativas de melhoria de processos, automação, mapeamento de riscos fiscais, aproveitamento de créditos, e adaptação a mudanças da legislação (como reforma tributária, por exemplo) ou cenários de negócio;
  • Apresentar análises gerenciais e relatórios executivos (em inglês, quando for o caso) à alta direção ou matriz, com propostas de ação, acompanhamento de metas e suportes decisórios.


Qualificações & requisitos:


  • Formação superior em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas. Preferencialmente com registro CRC ativo (quando aplicável);
  • Experiência sólida em operação fiscal/tributária, com apuração de tributos diretos e indiretos em ambiente corporativo;
  • Experiência comprovada em faturamento ou faturamento tributário (emissão de notas fiscais, retenções, faturamento em operação com produtos/serviços) e liderança de equipe;
  • Inglês avançado (oral e escrito) – para reportes, interface com clientes estrangeiros;
  • Perfil forte deliderança, com habilidades executivas — comunicação clara, capacidade de influenciar, visibilidade junto à diretoria, visão de negócio;
  • Familiaridade com KPIs, dashboards, relatórios gerenciais, e métricas de performance da área fiscal/faturamento;
  • Atuação em ambiente de alta demanda, com foco em prazos, entregas, auditorias e mudanças regulatórias;


Competências comportamentais:


  • Visão estratégica com mindset operacional (“hands-on”);
  • Alta capacidadeanalítica e atenção a detalhes;
  • Orientação pararesultados e melhoria contínua;
  • Excelente comunicação (com a equipe, stakeholders e diretoria);
  • Adaptabilidade e proatividade para lidar com mudanças rápidas (ex: reforma tributária, nova legislação);
  • Integridade, postura ética e foco em compliance;


Se você é um líder fiscal com visão estratégica, domínio técnico e capacidade de transformar operações através de performance, governança e indicadores, esta posição pode ser a oportunidade ideal para direcionar resultados com impacto direto no negócio.

title: Inspetor De Qualidade
description:
1. Missão do Cargo


Garantir que produtos, processos e materiais atendam aos requisitos especificados pela empresa, clientes e normas aplicáveis, por meio de inspeções, registros e monitoramentos sistemáticos, contribuindo para a melhoria contínua do Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade.


⸻


2. Principais Responsabilidades

- Realizar inspeções de recebimento, processo e produto final, conforme procedimentos e planos de inspeção.

- Registrar e manter atualizados os resultados das inspeções nos formulários, sistemas ou relatórios definidos.

- Identificar, segregar e registrar materiais ou produtos não conformes, comunicando aos responsáveis.

- Apoiar na investigação de não conformidades, realizar análises preliminares e sugerir ações corretivas/ver preventivas.

- Utilizar instrumentos de medição (paquímetro, micrômetro, gabaritos, etc.) garantindo conformidade com padrões.

- Preencher relatórios de inspeção, laudos e demais documentos relacionados ao controle da qualidade.

- Acompanhar testes e ensaios, garantindo que sejam cumpridos os requisitos técnicos.

- Auxiliar no monitoramento de indicadores da qualidade.

- Cumprir e fazer cumprir os procedimentos do Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade (ISO 9001 ou outros aplicáveis).

- Sugerir melhorias nos processos, produtos e métodos de inspeção.


⸻


3. Competências Técnicas

- Leitura e interpretação de desenhos técnicos (quando aplicável).

- Uso de instrumentos de medição e inspeção.

- Conhecimento básico/intermediário da ISO 9001.

- Registro e controle de não conformidades.

- Noções de ferramentas da qualidade (5S, diagrama de causa e efeito, PDCA, etc.).


⸻


4. Competências Comportamentais

- Atenção aos detalhes.

- Organização e disciplina nos registros.

- Comunicação clara e objetiva.

- Proatividade e foco em melhoria contínua.

- Imparcialidade e postura ética.

- Trabalho em equipe.


⸻


5. Formação e Experiência

- Ensino médio completo (técnico em qualidade ou áreas afins é diferencial).

- Experiência prévia em inspeção ou controle de qualidade.

- Desejável conhecimento em metrologia.

- Treinamentos específicos conforme a área de atuação (ex.: inspeção visual, instrumentos, processo produtivo).


⸻


6. Indicadores de Desempenho (KPIs)

- Taxa de retrabalho.

- Acuracidade de inspeção.

- Registros realizados dentro do prazo.

- Redução de não conformidades internas e externas.

- Cumprimento dos procedimentos de qualidade.

title: Product Owner
description:
ENGLISH RESUMES ONLY


JOB DESCRIPTION

The Product Owner (PO) for the Revenue Management System (RMS) is responsible for shaping and delivering integrated solutions that support pricing, demand forecasting, and revenue optimization. This role involves managing initiatives that span data engineering, machine learning, and user-facing interfaces. In addition to gathering and managing business requirements, the PO will be responsible for overseeing the full delivery lifecycle to ensure successful execution from concept through release.


DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Develop and maintain a backlog of features and enhancements spanning data pipelines, predictive models, and RMS user interfaces.

Identify and prioritize high-value opportunities to optimize pricing strategies and demand forecasting.

Gather, analyze, and document business requirements and translate them into detailed epics and user stories with clear descriptions, business rules, and acceptance criteria.

Own the full delivery lifecycle of features and enhancements, ensuring timely execution, alignment with stakeholders, and readiness for deployment.

Collaborate with Data Engineering on requirements for data sourcing, integration, and quality.

Partner with Data Science to define, deploy, and iterate on ML models and pricing algorithms.

Align with UI/UX and front-end teams to ensure a seamless user experience.

Facilitate cross-functional workshops and planning sessions with business stakeholders.

Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess product success and user adoption.

Ensure accurate documentation in Confluence and Jira for themes, epics, and tasks.

Coordinate with QA to validate features and ensure delivery meets requirements.

Promote continuous iteration based on stakeholder feedback and performance data.

Drive change management and support user training for new RMS features.

Ensure compliance with data governance, security, and regulatory standards.

Identify and mitigate risks associated with process and system changes.

Actively participate in Agile ceremonies including backlog grooming, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.

Perform other job-related functions as assigned.


QUALIFICATIONS

DEGREE TYPE:

Bachelor's Degree


FIELD(S) OF STUDY:

Business Management, Data Analytics, or related fields


EXPERIENCE;

  • Atleast 3 years of experience in end-to-end product ownership, product management, or delivery of data or optimization platforms.
  • Experience working across Data Engineering, Data Science, and UI Development teams, as well with multiple stakeholders and brand Revenue Management teams.
  • Experience working in Agile software development environments with cross-functional teams.
  • Industry experience in cruise, travel, or enterprise data systems is a plus.


COMPETENCIES/SKILLS

  • Exposure to revenue management, pricing systems, or forecasting tools is preferred
  • Strong understanding of Agile delivery methodologies and iterative development
  • Familiarity with data pipelines, ML model lifecycle, and modern UI patterns
  • Ability to define and refine user stories across technical and business domains
  • Proficient in Jira, Confluence, and backlog management tools
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Excellent facilitation, documentation, and analytical skills
  • Understanding of change management principles and user adoption strategies
  • High attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities
  • Strong business acumen and problem-solving capabilities
  • Adaptability in fast-paced, cross-functional environments


CERTIFICATIONS/LICENSES

Add certifications/licenses (if any) here.

  • Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or similar Agile certification preferred
  • Product Management or Lean Six Sigma certification is a plus

description:

We provide end-to end project services and have delivered over 200 successful Murex projects across all major asset-classes and sectors including investment banking, asset management, corporate treasury and insurance.

- Knowledge and hands on experience in implementing, developing and supporting various MX.3 proprietary modules for Enterprise Integration such as MxML Exchange, Datamart, MX.3 Accessibility and Extensibility APIs (.Net, Java, C++, and SOAP/REST Web services), Real-time bridging service, Market Data Cache Server, MX.3 Connectivity 2.0 framework, MX.3 Packaged interfaces including (but not limited to) MarkitWire, DTCC Global Trade Repository, MarginSphere, IceLink, FXAll, Market Data Import Tool etc., MX.3 End of Day processes and Trade Life Cycle Management using workflows engine. o Provide services in the domain of system integration, business intelligence and data flows through the full lifecycle of the MX.3: requirements analysis, configuration build, installation, training, upgrade, and production support.

o Professionally interact with Murex colleagues and clients.

o Contribute to project implementations

Participate in design, build, and test phases sometimes remotely and other times at the client site as needed.

Develop and maintain end-to-end configuration management packages etc. Install, Deploy and test Murex packaged interfaces like MDIT (market data interface tool), Markitwire, BSMT and MarkitCredit to receive live and end-of-day data from external providers like Bloomberg, Reuters, Markit, etc.

4. Work with technologies including SQL, Unix, and Murex proprietary standards like Murex Scripting Language (MSL), XMLF, etc. for client solutions.

o Use SQL for end-of-day report generation, STP (straight through processing) failure issues, P&L evaluation, for analyzing issues in trade feed and status Etc.

o Java programming skills are not essential but are a plus.

o Various Murex proprietary languages and formats: Data Query Language for querying in various screens in MX.3, MSL (Murex Scripting Language) for pre-trade logic, XMLF for post-trade flow processing, MxML in various contexts, etc.

o Create shell/python scripts for automation of day-to-day manual activities.


Understand requirements, analyze the problem areas of the current system and behavior of pre- trade and post-trade workflow, and integration points.

XML;

title: Account Executive - Marketing Solutions
description:
São Paulo/SP - Brazil


SiiLA is the dominant authority in commercial real estate news, data, and analysis across Latin America. Since our founding in 2015, we have built a reputation for delivering precise , reliable market intelligence with a relentless commitment to quality and integrity .


Powered by cutting-edge technology, SiiLA transforms raw data into actionable insights through subscription-based solutions trusted by the world’s top commercial real estate professionals. Our platform offers unparalleled transparency , empowering clients to make informed decisions in a rapidly evolving industry.


Visit our website: siila.Com.Br


About the Role:

Are you passionate about commercial real estate, technology, and helping others succeed? SiiLA is looking for an Account Executive who combines business acumen with a consultative approach to selling.

This is not just a sales role—it’s an opportunity to join a dynamic, fast-growing organization where your efforts will directly influence our continued success. We’re looking for someone who is eager to become an expert in our products, understands the nuances of the commercial real estate industry, and embraces the challenge of developing long-term client relationships.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop a deep understanding of SiiLA’s products, data, and the commercial real estate market to build credibility and be a trusted advisor to clients.
  • Understand the Platform's Advertising Features: Gain a deep knowledge of the platform’s advertising offerings, tools, and capabilities to effectively showcase the benefits to potential clients and maximize their value.
  • Strategize Advertising Solutions: Work closely with the marketing team to design customized advertising solutions for clients, utilizing platform features to target the right audience and enhance commercial real estate market visibility.
  • Client Consultation & Advisory: Serve as a trusted advisor by understanding clients’ needs and leveraging the platform’s advertising tools to achieve their business objectives, particularly in the commercial real estate sector.
  • Actively identify and qualify new business opportunities, leveraging a consultative selling approach to tailor solutions to client needs.
  • Engage with prospects through persistent outreach, effective listening, and thoughtful presentations to communicate SiiLA’s value proposition.
  • Performance Analysis & Reporting: Continuously monitor the performance of advertising campaigns on the platform, providing clients with insights and recommendations to optimize their campaigns.
  • Educate Clients on the Platform’s Value: Conduct presentations, training sessions, and workshops to educate clients on effectively using the platform’s advertising features, fostering long-term client relationships and engagement.
  • Collaborate with Product Development: Provide feedback to the product development team regarding client needs and industry trends, helping to refine and enhance the platform’s advertising benefits for greater market relevance.
  • Drive Client Acquisition & Retention: Proactively identify opportunities to acquire new clients and retain existing ones by showcasing the unique advantages and results that the platform’s advertising solutions deliver within the commercial real estate market.
  • Stay Current with Industry Trends: Keep updated with digital advertising and commercial real estate trends to ensure the platform remains competitive and aligned with market demands.
  • Take initiative to experiment, refine processes, and share ideas to help SiiLA scale in the Brazil Market and beyond.
  • Build strong relationships with prospects, clients, and industry stakeholders, maintaining trust and delivering value .
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure smooth onboarding and exceptional client experiences .

What Makes You a Great Fit:

· Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field.

· A minimum of three years of experience in Marketing sales, preferably within commercial real estate, technology, or a related industry.

· Strong business sense with the ability to qualify prospects effectively and identify opportunities for tailored solutions in Marketing.

· A natural curiosity and willingness to dive into data, technology, and market trends to build expertise and credibility.

· Entrepreneurial mindset with a drive to contribute to the growth of a fast-evolving organization and make a measurable impact.

· Excellent interpersonal skills and clear, effective communication in both English and Portuguese.

· Persistence and resilience in handling objections, with the ability to bounce back and stay motivated .

· Strong organizational skills to manage multiple priorities, stay on top of leads, and deliver results .

· Confidence and presence to engage with executives while remaining personable and approachable.

· Coachable and adaptable , with a continuous improvement mindset and the ability to apply feedback effectively.

title: Gerente She
description:
O Gerente de SHE é responsável pela implementação, otimização e gestão de processos da área de Segurança do Trabalho dentro de uma organização. Ele garante que a operação dos serviços seja eficientes, alinhadas com os objetivos estratégicos da área.


  • Assegurar o atendimento aos requisitos legais e corporativos aplicáveis a segurança do trabalho, objetivando a não ocorrência de acidentes e não conformidades.
  • Avaliar as condições ambientais de trabalho (riscos físicos), emitir relatório técnico e indicar medidas de controle.
  • Atuar imediatamente qualquer atividade que apresente risco grave e iminente de acidente do trabalho ou doença ocupacional.
  • Identificar e analisar riscos, acidentes e falhas, investigar as causas e propor medidas preventivas e corretivas para prevenir potenciais incidentes e/ou acidentes.
  • Acompanhar peritos e auditores nas avaliações ambientais e fiscalizações trabalhistas.
  • Acompanhar auditorias internas e externas do sistema integrado de gestão de acordo com as normas ISO 9001, ISO 14001 e ISO 45001. Garantir o atendimento ao plano de ação das observações e não conformidades registradas.
  • Monitorar os dados estatísticos de acidentes do trabalho, doenças profissionais e do trabalho, calcular a frequência e a gravidade.
  • Assegurar a gestão de equipe sob sua responsabilidade.
  • Promover a comunicação entre a Segurança e a gerência/diretoria dos sites.
  • Oferecer suporte ao negócio ao longo do ciclo de vida do projeto desde o planejamento, supervisão, monitoramento e documentação para assegurar a conformidade com os aspectos internos, externos e legais relacionados.


Requisitos:

  • Formação específica como engenheiro e com Pós-graduação em Segurança do Trabalho (habilitação nacional para o exercício da sua função).
  • Experiência com implantação de sistemas de gestão em Segurança do Trabalho e Meio Ambiente e/ou Liderança de Projetos na área.
  • Experiência com NR’s.
  • Experiência com clientes do ramo de logística.
  • Experiência em gestão e desenvolvimento de pessoas, aplicação de treinamentos, direção e experiência para ajudar a resolver desafios.
  • Conhecimento de sistemas Google Office, Microsoft Office, Power BI (será um diferencial).
  • Fluência em espanhol.


Atividades:

  • Elaborar os procedimentos, padrões, normas e instruções de trabalho para o desenvolvimento do serviço nos clientes.
  • Identificar requisitos legais e do cliente e integrá-los em documentos operacionais.
  • Treinar e capacitar equipe operacional.
  • Definir e elaborar os indicadores de segurança, gestão de serviços e implementar planos de melhoria.
  • Assessorar a equipe de supervisores e técnicos de segurança sobre riscos, controles e ações para garantir o cumprimento das normas do cliente.
  • Assessorar o cliente no cumprimento regulatório e requisitos legais.
  • Realizar auditorias de gestão e cumprimento das normas de serviço de acordo com os requisitos do plano anual de auditoria.


Perfil: liderança, organização, controle, orientação para resultados, desenvolvimento de pessoas e comunicação eficaz.

title: Analista Contábil
description:
OBJETIVO


Assegurar a correta contabilização das operações da empresa, garantindo a integridade das informações financeiras, a conformidade com normas contábeis e fiscais e o suporte a gestão por meio de análises, conciliações e relatórios gerencias.


RESPONSIBILIDADES


  1. Realizar conciliações de contas contábeis, incluindo clientes, fornecedores, estoque e demais contas do balanço.
  2. Realizar lançamentos contábeis e ajustes de contas.
  3. Coletar, validar e registrar as despesas com cartões corporativos e despesas com funcionários.
  4. Executar rotinas de importação e conferência da folha de pagamento no sistema.
  5. Apoiar auditorias internas e externas, preparando documentos, relatórios e esclarecimentos necessários.
  6. Realizar processos de intercompany, garantindo a correta conciliação e registro das operações entre empresas do grupo.
  7. Emitir nota fiscal de importação, receber o faturamento do despachante aduaneiro e realizar todos os lançamentos pertinente a operação.
  8. Registrar e controlar despesas antecipadas e ativo imobilizado, garantindo o rateio correto e amortização mensal.
  9. Auxiliar no fechamento contábil mensal e anual, garantindo prazos e qualidade das informações.
  10. Contribuir na melhoria contínua dos processos contábeis, propondo ajustes e automatizações quando necessário.


REQUISITOS


ESCOLARIDADE: Superior Bacharelado em ciências contábeis ou afins

EXPERIÊNCIA: 1 a 3 anos de experiência


HABILIDADES E CONHECIMENTOS :


  • Formação em Ciências Contábeis
  • Habilidade no Pacote Office principalmente Excel do intermediário para avançado.
  • Conhecimento sólido em contabilidade geral.
  • Experiência com conciliação de contas.
  • Conhecimento em intercompany, ativo imobilizado e despesas antecipadas.
  • Familiaridade com rotinas de folha de pagamento.
  • Domínio de Sistemas ERP.
  • Inglês desejável.
  • Ter participado de projetos de automação ou melhoria contínua será considerado um diferencial
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Capacidade analítica para interpretar informações financeiras e identificar inconsistências.
  • Proatividade para buscar soluções, melhoras processos e antecipar necessidades da área.
  • Boa comunicação.
  • Comprometimento com prazos e habilidades para trabalhar com múltiplas demandas simultâneas.
  • Trabalho em equipe, colaborando com diferentes setores e compartilhando informações de forma clara.

title: Coordenação De Centro De Distribuição
description:
Somos gente que cuida de gente.

Cada um com características, histórias e qualidades únicas, mas todos unidos pelo mesmo propósito: viver plenamente.

Temos orgulho da nossa história, por isso fazemos o nosso melhor hoje, sem deixar de olhar para o amanhã.


Se você preza pela valorização humana, integridade, foco no cliente, superação de resultados, sustentabilidade, inovação em soluções em tudo o que faz, vem fazer parte do nosso time de gigantes.


Como é o ambiente de trabalho?


Oferecemos um ambiente em que todos são protagonistas e agentes de transformação. Temos um excelente clima organizacional com pessoas engajadas em entregar os melhores resultados, assim como grandes oportunidades de crescimento para você.


Responsabilidades


  • Coordenar as atividades de recebimento de mercadorias, conferência de produtos, separação de pedidos e expedição, assegurando a integridade dos produtos.
  • Liderar e supervisionar equipes operacionais, incluindo supervisores, operadores de empilhadeiras, conferentes, e outros colaboradores do centro de distribuição.
  • Desenvolver planos operacionais eficientes, otimizando o fluxo de trabalho e garantindo a alocação adequada de recursos humanos e materiais.
  • Avaliar, implementar e otimizar o uso de tecnologias e sistemas para melhorar a eficiência operacional, como sistemas de gestão de armazém (WMS).
  • Promover e garantir práticas seguras de trabalho, implementando procedimentos de segurança e treinamentos para prevenir acidentes.
  • Implementar e manter padrões de qualidade, assegurando que os processos atendam aos requisitos da empresa e que os produtos sejam manuseados com precisão.
  • Estabelecer metas de desempenho e produtividade para a equipe, monitorando o progresso e implementando ações corretivas quando necessário.


Requisitos

  • Experiência em Coordenação de Centro de Distribuição;
  • Ensino superiorcompleto em Administração, Engenharia de Produção ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento emsistemas de gestão de armazém será considerado um diferencial;
  • Liderança, boa comunicação e visão estratégica são essenciais.

title: Assessor De Investimentos
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Assessor(a) de Investimentos para atuar de forma estratégica na construção e no fortalecimento do relacionamento com nossos clientes, oferecendo soluções financeiras personalizadas e alinhadas aos objetivos de curto, médio e longo prazo de cada cliente.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:


  • Onboarding (1º mês)
  • Um mês de imersão para você conhecer em profundidade nossos processos, ferramentas, cultura, soluções e a rotina estratégica do assessor na EQI.
  • Afinamento Comercial (2º mês)
  • Aqui você entra em um treinamento intensivo de vendas, prospecção e qualificação, aprendendo a gerar grandes oportunidades de negócio.
  • Captação e Estruturação (3º e 4º meses)
  • Além de seguir prospectando, você inicia a captação de recursos e a estruturação de carteiras, adquirindo experiência prática e recebendo, ao final, uma base de clientes para gestão e relacionamento.
  • Prospectar, desenvolver e fechar negócios com investidores de alta renda em todo o Brasil;
  • Manter ótimo relacionamento com clientes através de visitas e contatos recorrentes;
  • Estar constantemente atualizado sobre cenário macroeconômico, bem como oportunidades de mercado e produtos financeiros;
  • Assessorar e acompanhar constantemente a carteira de investimentos do cliente com foco em seus objetivos;
  • Saber gerenciarseu funil de vendas no CRM, com foco em levantar forecast e redução de ciclo comercial para atingimento de metas.



O que importa no nosso processo seletivo?

- Fit Cultural;

- Certificação CPA-20, CEA ou CFP;

- Conhecimento sobre Investimentos (RV, RF, Fundos, entre outros);

- Perfil comercial e relacional;

- Disponibilidadeem tempo integral (100% presencial);

- Experiência mínima de 6 meses de atuação profissional no Mercado Financeiro (Banco, Corretora, AAI ou Family Office).


Por que escolher a EQI?

  • Plano de carreira estruturado e diferenciado
  • Suporte e acompanhamento integral das lideranças no dia a dia
  • Feedbacks estruturados
  • Sistemas avançados e tecnologias de ponta
  • Plataformas próprias de desenvolvimento profissional (EaD) com mais de 350 treinamentos disponíveis (habilidades técnicas e comportamentais)
  • Partnership



Informações adicionais


Benefícios:

Salário + PPR Anual

title: Especialista Em Melhoria Contínua - Jacareí
description:
RESUMO DO CARGO


Essa pessoa será responsável por promover a cultura de melhoria contínua nas operações, garantindo a padronização dos processos conforme os padrões globais.

Entre suas principais atividades estão o suporte ao planejamento e execução de treinamentos Belt (Lean Six Sigma), a identificação e lançamento de projetos de melhoria de diferentes níveis de complexidade, e o acompanhamento da governança dos projetos entre as plantas. Também será responsável por desenvolver processos de gestão e garantir que o AMPS esteja integrado à rotina operacional das fábricas, assegurando consistência e entrega de resultados.



RESPONSABILIDADES


  1. Suportar à implementação do AMPS (Ardagh Metal Production System) nas unidades de latas e tampas da Ardagh Metal Packaging, com o objetivo de disseminar a cultura de melhoria contínua nas áreas de operações, além da padronização do modelo aos padrões globais.
  2. Suportar o processo de planejamento, implementação e execução dos treinamentos de formação Belt, bem como o suporte na identificação e lançamento de novos projetos de baixa, média e alta complexidade, com o objetivo de garantir o alcance de resultados alinhados as metas da organização.
  3. Apoiar a coordenação corporativa do programa AMPS, por meio do acompanhamento da execução da implementação e governança dos Use Cases, com o objetivo de garantir o padrão de ferramentas e abordagens entre as plantas, aderência ao padrão global e entrega de resultados para a organização.
  4. Desenvolver e atuar em processos de governança e acompanhamento na gestão de ferramentas e processos do programa AMPS de forma a acompanhar sua implementação, incorporação da gestão de rotina das fábricas bem com aderência aos padrões.


Pré-Requisitos

  • Superior Completo, preferencialmente em Engenharia.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em:
  • Lean Manufacturing e Seis Sigma.
  • Gestão de Rotina.
  • Hoshin Kanri.
  • Metodologias de análise de falhas (A3/8D).
  • Gestão de projetos.
  • Black Belt Certificado.
  • Inglês avançado.
  • Pacote Office
  • Sistema ERP: SAP
  • Disponibilidade para viagens


Sobre a Ardagh

A Ardagh Metal Packaging (AMP) é uma das líderes globais na produção e venda de embalagens de alumínio para bebidas, com 3 unidades de produção no Brasil - fábricas de latas em Jacareí (SP) e Alagoinhas (BA) e uma fábrica de tampas de Manaus (AM) – e um escritório localizado em São Paulo. Globalmente, a AMP opera 24 instalações de produção nas Américas e Europa, empregando cerca de 5.800 funcionários e registrou receitas de US $ 4 bilhões em 2021. A inclusão, confiança, trabalho em equipe e excelência são nossos valores e junto com o talento que buscamos, serão a fórmula perfeita para crescermos juntos!


Somos apaixonados por sustentabilidade e temos uma ótima reputação pela inovação e qualidade que oferecemos a nossos clientes. Nós somos pioneiros em novos métodos de produção, novas técnicas de design e novas formas de reciclar e economizar energia. Nosso objetivo é reduzir os impactos ambientais, enquanto permanecemos economicamente sustentáveis e socialmente responsáveis.


Na Ardagh, temos a consciência da singularidade de cada ser humano. Valorizamos e respeitamos a diversidade da nossa rede de colaboradores. Aqui, você pode ser você, contribuindo com suas experiências para o nosso negócio. Afinal, cada um é um mundo, e, na Ardagh, todo mundo importa! Gostou? #VEM ser você :)



Se seu perfil corresponde à vaga, candidate-se a essa posição e #VEMserLateiroAMP.

description:

ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. 2.Material Flow Optimization: Analyze inbound, put-away, picking and outbound processes;
optimize material flow and work areas to increase efficiency.

3.Time Studies: Conduct detailed time studies and work sampling to establish and maintain standard operating times.

4.Capacity & ROI Analysis: Develop cost–benefit and ROI models for layout changes, automation investments and process improvements.

5.New Project Support: Provide IE support for new warehouse start-ups, process changes and layout integrations.

6.Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with operations, safety, IT and automation teams to ensure smooth implementation of changes.


Requirements

1.Bachelor’s degree or above in Industrial Engineering, Logistics Engineering, Operations Management or related fields.

2.5+ years of experience in warehouse IE, layout design or process improvement.

3.Familiarity with IE tools such as time studies, motion studies and capacity balancing.

4.Proficient in AutoCAD/Visio for layout design and Excel/Power BI for data analysis and reporting.

5.Strong numerical analysis and ROI modeling skills.

6.Excellent cross-department communication and coordination skills.

7.Good command of spoken and written English.
